system.flavor:
Force one person to show their hand: a guard steps out from his post, a bluffing gambler calls, a thief breaks from the crowd and runs. While they are rattled, a friend slips past or gets a step ahead.

Not enough to make them act against their own interest, or to draw out more than one person.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, the target is Distracted until the start of your next turn; you gain +1 Fortitude against it during that time.

surges.html: Move 1 unit toward or around it.
On a hit, it is Slowed 2 until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Authority - Order
rider.html: Spend this Authority when the target declares an Action against you before your next turn: one willing creature within 3 units, including you, may move 1 unit before that Action rolls.
